## Observation

Expected behavior, actual behavior, smallest reproduction, and relevant state/reason.

## Environment And Evidence

Ubuntu version, CPU architecture, ROS distribution, source revision or ZIP identity,
exact command, first error, and relevant sanitized logs. Was this actually run or
only observed during source review? Include parameters and command source/session
changes for control failures. Do not attach secrets, personal paths, or recordings
without reviewing their contents. No hardware safety claims apply to this simulator.
